newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian beauty pageant marred by "Duck Hug".
newsitem.headline: Colombian beauty pageant marred by "Duck Hug".

text.p: An illness known as the "Duck Hug" is wreaking havoc with Colombia's annual beauty pageant in the Caribbean port city of Cartagena, local news reports said on Tuesday.

The Caracol radio network said 15 of 22 candidates for the Miss Colombia crown had been hit by the virus, which was detected for the first time last month and has been associated with at least 20 deaths along the Caribbean coast.

The virus, which causes breathing difficulties, severe aches and coughing, has been identified by Health Ministry officials as a strain of flu previously unknown in Colombia. It takes its name from a popular dance in the area in which partners cling to one another so tightly it almost cuts off their breath.
